communication_data_handoff.title: Streamline Intermediate Handoff Payloads to Field-Specific Deltas
communication_data_handoff.observed_problem: Workflow passes full document and global context payloads across sequential agent boundaries (35 detected handoff edges). Intermediate agents receive unneeded upstream metadata, inflating prompt token consumption across every stage.
communication_data_handoff.proposed_solution: Replace raw full-state serialization with typed, field-specific projection schemas. Each agent receives strictly its declared input requirements and emits only newly computed attributes.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Reduces context dilution and LLM attention distraction.

tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: 20-25% reduction in cumulative workflow token volume.

model_selection.title: Route normalize_agent to openai/gpt-oss-20b (JEV Agent 2 Recommendation; requires validation)
model_selection.observed_problem: Agent 'normalize_agent' performs structured syntactic extraction and text normalization. Assigning the high-parameter 120B model ('openai/gpt-oss-120b') introduces unnecessary latency (1.60s) and compute overhead for straightforward parsing tasks.
model_selection.proposed_solution: Switch 'normalize_agent' from 'openai/gpt-oss-120b' to 'openai/gpt-oss-20b' per the 2-agent JEV LangGraph workflow (Agent 2 recommendation) with structured schema output validation.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Requires shadow validation against baseline traces to confirm behavioral equivalence.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Substantial speedup on first-stage document intake.
tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: ~50.0% API pricing reduction vs. 'openai/gpt-oss-120b' based on Groq catalog rates.
tradeoffs_and_risks.output_quality_risk: Moderate (compact model recommended by JEV Agent 2 requires empirical shadow validation against baseline traces).

agent_consolidation.title: Consolidate receipt_agent and normalize_agent into Unified Agent
agent_consolidation.observed_problem: Agents 'receipt_agent' and 'normalize_agent' share tightly coupled operational scopes and require high intermediate data handoffs. Executing them as separate LLM agents introduces redundant context re-loading and inter-agent serialization latency (4.06s + 1.60s = 5.66s).
agent_consolidation.proposed_solution: Merge 'receipt_agent' and 'normalize_agent' into a single specialized agent with unified system instructions, eliminating the intermediate payload serialization and reducing prompt token re-transmission.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Maintains full reasoning fidelity by handling extraction and categorization in a single coherent prompt.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Significant latency reduction by eliminating one agent dispatch round-trip.
tradeoffs_and_risks.output_quality_risk: Low (joint extraction is well within standard LLM contextual capabilities).
